归档后不再参与新搭配，原有记录仍保留。: Archived items are excluded from new suggestions. Existing records remain.
没有衣物被手动标记为待洗。: No items manually marked for washing.
每一次状态变化都有记录: A record of each status change

更新衣物状态后会出现在这里。: Saved care status changes will appear here.
主动记录穿着后，这里会展示登记次数。: Record actual wear to see counts here.
类别和记录覆盖仅统计未归档衣物。: Categories and record coverage include active items only.

计划不会自动计入穿着次数；历史不会在 30 天后自动删除。统计页的 30 / 6: Plans do not count as wear, and history is not deleted after 30 days. The 30 / 60 / 90 day filters show time without records, not proof that an item was unworn.
请先到搭配实验室保存一套搭配。: Save an outfit in the outfit studio first.
这天还没有计划，给日常一点期待。: No outfit planned for this day yet.

保存计划不会增加穿着次数，确认已穿后才计入统计。: Saving a plan does not add to wear counts. Confirm actual wear to record it.

删除后，已经生成的实际穿着记录仍会保留。: Existing wear records will remain after deletion.
已经保存的计划和实际穿着记录会保留。: Saved plans and wear records will remain.

这条记录保留供查阅，已从统计中排除。: Kept for reference and excluded from statistics.

账号和照片仅保存在这台设备。示例衣橱独立存储，可随时切换到自己的账号。: Accounts and photos stay on this device. The demo wardrobe is separate; switch to your own account at any time.
